snippet.title: Arcade Game: Warrior (1979 Vectorbeam)
snippet.description:
The world's first 1-on-1 commercial weapon-based fighting game. While Sega's HeavyWeight Champ released in 1976 was the first fist fight game pre-dating this game. Atari's boxer released in 1978 was second. Definitely would not appeal today's hardcore fighting game fans. Recommended to die-hard fans of 70s games.  With vector (wireframe) graphics

Used MAME Artwork to better demonstrate the game for a better accurate representation of this game.
